head: 9 new health and fitness apps climbing the App Store this week
dek: These health and fitness apps came out in the last 60 days and rose into the US App Store's paid Health & Fitness charts this week, from a step graph for the Apple Watch and a running app to a newborn log and breathing exercises.
where: iPhone (some also Apple Watch or iPad), US App Store Health & Fitness charts (paid) this week
means: If you're tired of fitness apps with monthly fees, most of these new ones are a single purchase between 99 cents and $9.99.
todo: Read the App Store page before you buy: On Pace is made for the Apple Watch face, and The Birth Bag says it is a support tool for birth partners, not medical advice.

list.name: On Pace: Steps vs Average
list.what: Shows today's steps against your average day, the same comparison as the Health app, on your Apple Watch face and iPhone Home Screen.

list.name: echoRnr
list.what: A running app you pay for once that lets you race one of your past runs or a friend's in real time, with GPS maps and Apple Watch support.

list.name: FitIn7
list.what: A 7-minute home workout of 12 bodyweight exercises, 30 seconds each, with an animated figure showing every move.

list.name: The Birth Bag
list.what: A labor support tool made by a doula for birth partners, doulas and nurses, with a contraction timer, 74 position guides and comfort ideas.
list.maker: Nurture and Connect Doula Services LLC

list.name: Baby Log & Head Time
list.what: Logs a newborn's feedings, sleep and diapers with one tap each, and tracks how long the baby lies on each side of the head.

list.name: aire
list.what: Guided breathing sessions for relaxation, focus and sleep, with suggestions that can use your Apple Health sleep and heart rate data.

list.name: Second Wind: Breathwork
list.what: Breathwork sessions for athletes, shaped by your sleep, training, heart rate variability and resting heart rate.

list.name: YourTrackPal: GPS Tracker
list.what: A GPS tracker for ten sports, from running and cycling to skiing, paddling and swimming, with your stats over a live map.

list.name: Daybreak: Health Export
list.what: Exports your Apple Health history to JSON and CSV files in a folder you choose, up to 80 daily metrics.
